checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-goals.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" goals --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'ao goals [command]' "$tmp/help"; for child in drift export history measure meta render scenarios validate; do grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]+$child([[:space:]]|,)" "$tmp/help"; done; "$tmp/ao" goals --help | grep -Fq -- '--file'; "$tmp/ao" goals --help | grep -Fq -- '--timeout'; "$tmp/ao" goals measure --help >"$tmp/measure"; for flag in goal directives exclude-tag total-timeout scenarios-only; do grep -Fq -- "--$flag" "$tmp/measure"; done; "$tmp/ao" goals scenarios --help | grep -Fq -- '--lint'; "$tmp/ao" goals render --help | grep -Fq -- '--out'

tracker_selection.reason: The goals family does not select a repository issue tracker.
